role: Dated research and gap picks. Only a bound two-sided prematch price or the documented Valve-rating research model may produce the probabilities recorded here. Hotspawn crowd percentages and HLTV fan votes are never inputs.

Resolution reuses scripts/originate.py's reviewed ladder. An even estimate never receives an invented side.
